repos_data.description: MCP server that generates quality control plans and inspection reports from technical-drawing PDFs — tolerances, fits, threads, GD&T and surface finishes extracted automatically, balloon numbering, acceptance limits, ballooned drawing PDF and Excel measurement report. By Imnoo, powers quality-check-protocol.imnoo.com.
MCP server for converting technical drawings (PDF) and engineering callouts between metric and imperial — dimensions, fits, tolerances, threads, surface roughness.
Anonymize technical-drawing PDFs before sharing them — mask company names, logos, people, addresses and contact data; flattened, metadata-free PDF or an expiring share link.
